failure.en: Front/back show a sparse few loops with large empty spaces; left view is almost planar; abrupt visible junction step between duodenum and coils.
failure.zh: 原小肠只有稀疏近乎平面的弯管，上方连接有明显接缝。

cause.en: Primitive curve centreline was treated as finished anatomy. Smooth tube shading cannot supply volumetric packing or anatomical routing.
cause.zh: 把曲线路径和光滑管材误当成完成的解剖形态。

change.en: BodyParts3D source exterior replacement; see precise bridge/motion/fragment-cleanup receipt.
change.zh: 替换为 BodyParts3D 外表面；仅修复十二指肠到近端空肠的相邻接头；保留近端呼吸随动。

lesson.en: Review three-dimensional packing and junction continuity from side and back before polishing materials.
lesson.zh: 先看侧面体积与接头拓扑，再做材质；看起来光滑不等于网格合格。

limits.en: Closed exterior modeling boundaries, no continuous validated lumen. Taenia ribbons are source-derived teaching surfaces, not photographic tissue finish.
limits.zh: 保留封闭的外表面建模边界，不代表连续且经验证的肠腔。结肠带是来源图谱的教学表面，不是照片级组织材质。
